title: Chapter 449 War Begins
content:
Chapter 449 War Begins

A depressed atmosphere permeated the entire Chaos Realm, and the weak creatures could only tremble and kept praying in their hearts.

The more powerful creatures looked solemn and lacked confidence in the upcoming war.

Seeing more and more creatures from the land of Gods come out of the black hole, Lu Xue sighed in her heart. This battle must be extremely tragic. Even if the Chaos Realm can really win in the end, it will definitely be a tragic victory.

"Dad, you're really relieved."

Lu Xue sighed lightly, then said, "Don't be underestimated by them."

After being reminded by Lu Xue, some timid strong men were immediately ashamed and quickly forced themselves to raise their heads and look at the creatures in other worlds.

By now, the invaders in the Land of Gods have been densely packed. They not only have terrifying creatures in it, but also have huge military power.

The strength of the army must not be ignored. Once it is condensed together, it can definitely turn into the sharpest sword on the battlefield and penetrate all flaws.

At this time, Lu Xue suddenly missed Yunqi very much.

If Yun Qi led the Lu family army here, why would Lu Xue be afraid of the army of the gods?

"Didn't the priest come?"

Outside the Chaos Realm, the sickle monster suddenly asked the people around him.

But the answer I got was to shake my head.

The sickle monster frowned, stared at the Chaos Realm, and snorted softly, "I never expected that the shell of this small world would be so difficult to chew."

After they came here, they had launched more than once, but they were all light curtains that could not break through the Chaos Realm, and they could only create a tiny ripples.

We must find a way to break the light curtain first.

"Hey, Sanyan, have you seen anything?"

The sickle monster shouted at the three-eyed creature on the other side.

At this time, the three-eyed monster was opening its third eye, and its strange pupils kept shining on the light curtain of the Chaos Realm.

Hearing the scythe monster questioning, the three-eyed monster withdrew its pupil light and a wicked smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, "Can the little light curtain be so rare to beat me?"

"Do you have a way?" The sickle monster showed a surprise smile, and a fierce light suddenly appeared in his eyes.

He could no longer wait to enter the Chaos Realm and massacre.

It seems that only murder can bring him pleasure.

"That's certainly."

The three-eyed monster smiled and looked like he was in control.

He pointed at the Chaos Realm light curtain and said confidently: "This light curtain is full of energy and has extremely strong defense. I am afraid that only the priest or the master will come to break through it."

"We have killed so many worlds, and we have never seen any world with such a light curtain, so I guess this is the result of the research and development of the creatures in this world at a huge cost. As long as we break through this light curtain, then The creatures in this world have no power to fight back.”

When the powerful people in the land of gods heard this, they nodded slightly.

"I am worthy of being the Lord God-Eye."

The sickle monster snorted coldly, "You have said so much, and you have said a lot of nonsense. What I want to know is, how to break through the light curtain?"

"Ha, you skunk is really brainless. I haven't finished speaking yet."

The three-eyed creature glanced at the sickle monster and curled his lips disdainfully, making the sickle monster tremble all over, "How many times have you said it, call me a sickle weasel!"

Ignoring the furious fury of the sickle monster, the three-eyed creature continued to talk and laugh, "This light curtain has been produced for a long time and has been weakening. Even if I can't wait, the light curtain will disappear on its own in time, and today , some parts of this light curtain are already full of flaws."

As he said that, the third eye of the three-eyed creature suddenly shone brightly, as bright as light.

With a whoosh.

A laser light shot at a certain place above the light curtain, which was where Lu Xue and others were.

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue and others looked heavy.

He actually found the weakest place directly.

These creatures in other worlds are indeed possessing unique skills.

"Prepare!"

Lu Xue raised her hand and slowly retreated with everyone.

The next moment.

A loud noise was made at the location of the light curtain in front of Lu Xue and others.

Rumble!

The light curtain shattered a hole, which was very small, and could only allow two people to enter at the same time.

But even so, it still made the faces of the people in the Chaos Realm look ugly.

"Ha ha ha ha."

The Scythe monster couldn't help laughing out loud, waved the sickle and rushed into the hole, shouting while rushing, "Three-eyed cubs are doing well, your grandfather, I'll rush first!"

Immediately, the sickle monster was about to rush into the entrance of the cave and enter the Chaos Realm.

Seeing this scene, the three-eyed creature was not angry at all, but instead showed a faint smile.

Immediately afterwards, a scream came.

"ah!!"

The sickle monster looked painful and flew backwards, with blood still on the corner of his mouth.

Seeing that the sickle monster failed to enter the cave, he was injured instead. The other creatures in the land of the gods who wanted to rush together immediately stopped in place, with a look of fear.

"What's going on here? Three-eyed cub, are you cheating me?"

Feeling the hatred gaze mixed with sickle, the three-eyed creature laughed and said, "You are stupid, you can't blame me."

"Although there is a gap in the light curtain, it is not something that strong people like you and me can enter at this moment."

The sickle monster had quickly recovered from his injuries at this time. He looked at the three-eyed creature and said in confusion: "What do you mean?"

The three-eyed creature looked at the hole that could only enter two people at the same time, and his expression gradually became heavier, and his voice was low: "I have to say that this light curtain is indeed very accurate, so we are the strong ones." Being restricted, unable to enter, but weaker compatriots can force them into it."

Speaking of this, the powerful people from the Land of Gods had already understood and looked at the entrance of the cave with some gaze.

The three-eyed creature laughed and said, "Who wants to take the lead?"

As soon as he finished speaking, a strong man with a huge body, like a hill, stood up, with a fierce aura in his eyes, "Sir Divine Eye, I'm willing to take the lead!"

Everyone looked at the giant strong man with a strange look.

The smile on the faces of the three-eyed creature gradually disappeared.

"You can't."

"Why? Could it be that I am too strong and I am also bound by this light curtain?" The giant strong man said unwillingly.

The three-eyed creature shook his head, "No, you are too fat."

"Even if I use my means to narrow you down, there are still many restrictions on the hole."

Hearing this reason, the giant creature stood there in a daze. After a long time, he said a little aggrievedly: "I am strong."

Soon, several strong men stood up and expressed their willingness to take the lead.

The three-eyed creature picked one of the most energetic strong men from them, and then sent him to the first to enter the Chaos Realm.

With the help of the three-eyed creature and the sickle monster, the strong man successfully entered the Chaos Realm.

In the Chaos Realm.

The strongest people entered the land of the gods.
